title: 3890. Integers With Multiple Sum of Two Cubes

examples.explanation: Among integers less than or equal to 4104, the good integers are: 1729: 13 + 123 = 1729 and 93 + 103 = 1729. 4104: 23 + 163 = 4104 and 93 + 153 = 4104. Thus, the answer is [1729, 4104].
There are no good integers less than or equal to 578, so the answer is an empty array.
